strategy: Full unit suite plus affected/new native UI runs in light and actual dark appearance.
scope_statement: This pass reran all 628 unit tests and selected affected UI tests. The source contains 121 UI tests; the full 121-case UI suite was not rerun in this pass. Two final-source Today follow-ups cover the final artwork scrim and naturally growing header in light and dark; they are UI-only and do not add another full-unit-suite claim. Two report follow-ups rerun the existing normal report case after a screenshot-only settling adjustment; they are additional UI executions, not additional distinct tests or new product behavior. Historical 119-case coverage is provenance only and is not current-pass execution coverage.

previous_ui_verification.scope: Earlier full sweep followed by repairs and focused reruns, not one all-green unfiltered command.

launch_measurement.classification: Simulator baseline, not a physical-device benchmark or an improvement claim.

limitations: Selected UI execution does not establish that every current UI case was rerun.
Settled report screenshots are still-state evidence. Motion video is separate evidence; neither passing UI cases nor a settled still establish animation smoothness or hardware performance.
Simulator runs do not establish physical VoiceOver, haptics, OLED, Always-On, integration authorization or supported-hardware performance.
No owner-device identifier, raw launch command, user tracking data or native hierarchy is copied into this record.
